coordinate_note: The viewer enumerates hypotheses; no hypothesis is automatically claimed correct.

hypotheses.label: 1 Camera: stored translation
hypotheses.description: Depth and SMPL both remain in camera coordinates. Tests K, depth scale, pose and stored smplx_transl.

hypotheses.label: 2 Camera: stored translation - pose.t
hypotheses.description: Tests the historical adapter alternative: stored smplx_transl may contain an extra pose translation.

hypotheses.label: 3 World: pose is W2C, stored translation
hypotheses.description: x_world = R^T (x_cam - t). Static geometry should align across frames if pose is world-to-camera.

hypotheses.label: 4 World: pose is W2C, stored translation - pose.t
hypotheses.description: W2C world transform plus the historical extra-translation correction.

hypotheses.label: 5 World: pose is C2W, stored translation
hypotheses.description: x_world = R x_cam + t. Static geometry should align across frames only if pose is camera-to-world.

hypotheses.label: 6 World: pose is C2W, stored translation - pose.t
hypotheses.description: C2W world transform plus the historical extra-translation correction.
